AgencyAnalytics Discovery Call 10:00 (0.75 hr, external, + vendor), [INT] OUE Pitch Regroup 16:00 (was Nat x Steph 1-1), [INT] Pru Finance Catch-up 16:30 and chijmes report catch up 18:00 (both new).
■ Benelic — we won it. Benelic is now a client, not a pitch. New Monday board (Benelic), launch Wed 2 Dec 2026 — tight runway. Media drop due today: Beverly’s planner subtask Done (1 hr); Renny’s and Bernetta’s art subtasks briefed in, due today. New meeting today: [INT] Benelic Regroup, Fri 11:30, 1 hr, 10 people (Clarie, Stephanie, Kelvin, Natalie, CJ, Cher, Beverly, Bernetta, Renny, Rachel). Benelic’s board carries its deadline in a “Due Date” column — that column counts as its deadline (exception for this board only); the wider Due Date question for the other boards is still open.
■ Garrett Reshoot correction: [INT] Garrett Regroup – Reshoot for Christmas, Fri 11:00, was a discussion, not a shoot — it now counts as an internal meeting (3.5 person-hours), not a shoot. Shoots so far stay at 1 (SKM, 12.0 hrs).
■ Capitol Shoot, Fri 6 Nov 2–5pm, is no longer on any team calendar — cancelled or moved, not rescheduled next week (checked Sherman’s calendar 9–15 Nov: Luckin Shoot 12 Nov, DTG Shoot 13 Nov, no Capitol). The creative booking site now notes its removal, pending your confirmation. Please confirm what happened — I have not changed any calendar entry.
■ Still scheduled Fri–Sun: 7 meetings (24.25 hrs), 0 shoots — REMINDER: SUBMIT SAM BI-WEEKLY REPORT 09:00 (counts, known quirk), [INT] Garrett MY Regroup 10:00 (now 0.25 hr, was 1 hr), Reshoot 11:00 (0.5 hr, meeting), [INT] Benelic Regroup 11:30 (1 hr, new), chat 12:00, chats Ber 15:00, chats celine 16:00.
■ Monday: 16 tasks due this week still open (was 15 this morning), 2 due today (Fri) — both Benelic media drop art, Renny and Bernetta. 0 rest of week (Sat–Sun). Overdue 72 (was 73) — Garrett Inside Out Art–Ber (due 5 Nov) cleared since this morning. Cleared since yesterday: CJ’s CHIJMES Christmas Markets AD (Done, no hours recorded), Beverly’s FRAMEWORK PLANNER – BEV (Done, 2 hrs), Renny’s SKM Just Checking In Art director (Done, 2.5 hrs).
■ Blocked: 13, unchanged. No-deadline, posting this week: 5 (was 7). Done with blank hours, deadline in week: 3 — Riduwan, World Hello Day PROD (due 3 Nov) and Random Kindness Pranks PROD (due 4 Nov); Sherman, Random Kindness Pranks PROD (due 4 Nov). Flag, do not estimate cost. OT = exceeding 6 productive hours in a day — cannot be calculated reliably while hours are blank for most due tasks.
■ Method gap: the locked totals above use subtask Deadline/Date columns only, except Benelic (Due Date counts for that board, see above). Including Due Date / Due date boards would add, for today: 2 more due today (SAM Go To An Art Museum Day Prod 2; SAM Closing ANIM), 0 rest of week, 9 more due earlier this week still open, and 43 more overdue (116 total). 3 of those 9 are the Prudential Script items already shown in the locked no-deadline bucket. Tell me if Due Date boards should be folded into the locked totals — I have not changed the basis without your say-so.
■ Focus time: today’s Fri 6 Nov check stays silent. First flagging run Mon 9 Nov, covering 11 Nov onwards. Small check-ins ≤15 min are exempt.
■ Leave / away: Tristan’s honeymoon and CJ’s leave start today. Clarie out 10–11 Nov (shared calendar; the old card said 8–11 Nov — corrected), back Thu 12 Nov. Beverly KL citizenship 10–12 Nov. Riduwan reservist to Fri 13 Nov (shared calendar; the old card said 15 Nov — the email said 15 Nov). New: Ber WFH Fri 20 Nov, Riduwan WFH Fri 20 Nov, Bernetta away down under from Sat 21 Nov.
